interject_note: Not re-measured since the Qoder finding. The hint list below is the same generic guess, and this profile still relies on the strict at-rest gate (interject_after_send is absent), so an urgent note is refused unless a matching control is visible before anything is typed. That refusal is safe but may be a false negative for the same reason Qoder's was: a client that only shows the control after a message is queued looks like it has no channel at all. Measure with paste+Enter, not ValuePattern, before adding interject_after_send here.
